releases.title: PoemWorld 4.0.1 self-contained trial package
releases.author: builder
releases.body:
PoemWorld 4.0.1 is a self-contained trial package fixing the v1 installation and delivery findings.

Download `poemworld-4.0.1-source.tar.gz` and verify SHA-256:

```text
c550e916712ef2ec972f8571d4b53a6f6acf003ea817d353440b74090bf6da34
```

From a fresh machine with Python 3.9+ and Docker, with no GitHub credentials:

```sh
tar -xzf poemworld-4.0.1-source.tar.gz
cd poemworld-4.0.1
bash install.sh
export PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH"
python .agents/tests/test-gateway-providers.py
python .agents/tests/test-roles-instruction.py
python .agents/tests/test-world-lifecycle.py
```

The installer uses only the attached source tree, installs the complete kernel and bundled domains, and builds `poemworld:local` and `poemworld-worker:local`. The attached trial log records fresh extraction, image builds, and passing suites (99, 81, and 89 tests) on trial-machine.

Run the PoemWorld trial with Claude Code model `claude-sonnet-5-5`, low effort, `claude-oauth` and credential environment `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_2`, at most 16 executions and 2000 model seconds. Use the exact input `Write a four-line poem about the first snow.` and drive checkpoint, stop/resume, and release; record the world id and editor-approved released poem.

releases.title: PoemWorld 4.0.0 trial package
releases.author: builder
releases.body:
PoemWorld 4.0.0 source artifact for the operator trial.

Download `poemworld-4.0.0-source.tar.gz` and verify SHA-256:

```text
d093f3098473c2faf1c843dbbd849aa2726dd12df063d2f69d461c68fdf3548a
```

The archive is self-contained at builder release commit `11a691986c29cdf77895e402ea03709ad2601ec6`; it includes the full kernel, domain package, Dockerfiles, definitions, tests, and installer. From a fresh machine with Docker and Python 3.12:

```sh
tar -xzf poemworld-4.0.0-source.tar.gz
cd poemworld-4.0.0
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install ./src/hutian ./src/poemworld
.venv/bin/poemworld --help
version=$(.venv/bin/poemworld --version | awk '{print $2}')
commit=11a691986c29cdf77895e402ea03709ad2601ec6
docker build --build-arg HUTIAN_VERSION="$version" --build-arg HUTIAN_COMMIT="$commit" -f src/poemworld/Dockerfile -t poemworld:local .
docker build -f src/hutian/hutian/execution/runtime.Containerfile -t hutian-runtime:local .
docker build --build-arg BASE=hutian-runtime:local -f src/poemworld/worker.Dockerfile -t poemworld-packages:local .
docker build --build-arg HUTIAN_VERSION="$version" --build-arg HUTIAN_COMMIT="$commit" --build-arg BASE=poemworld-packages:local -f src/hutian/hutian/execution/Containerfile -t poemworld-worker:local .
```

`bash install.sh` is also available when GitHub SSH access is configured; it installs all domain CLIs and builds the same images. Use Claude Code model `claude-sonnet-5-5`, low effort, `claude-oauth`, credential environment `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_2`, at most 16 executions and 2000 model seconds. Run the exact input `Write a four-line poem about the first snow.` The trial must checkpoint, stop/resume, and prove the editor-approved poem equals the released poem.
